name: Night-shift readiness brief (design story)
text: For the 3 most populous countries, find earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 or more from the last 7 days and write a short readiness brief for each.

name: Largest countries by area
text: For the 4 largest countries by area, find earthquakes of magnitude 5.0 or more from the last 14 days and write a short readiness brief for each.

name: Two countries, tight budget
text: For the 2 most populous countries, find earthquakes of magnitude 4.0 or more from the last 30 days and write a short readiness brief for each.
